# Portfonia

> Portfonia provides a personal data API for a user's own AI agent: reports, complete daily holding snapshots, holding-related intelligence and strict current-holdings management. Access uses personal API tokens and subscription entitlements. Portfonia provides information and context, not investment advice.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://portfonia.com/agent.md): Authentication, endpoints, response schemas, limits and data handling.
- [Human guide and token settings](https://portfonia.com/agent): Getting started and personal token management.

## Current holdings management

- [Current holdings contract](https://portfonia.com/agent.md#current-holdings-advanced-or-jade): Active Advanced/Jade can GET current holdings and validate complete replacement, creation, single replacement or PATCH with either token permission. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE changes require holdings-write permission. Stable IDs, decimal strings, explicit deletions and current versions apply; empty books and last-row Agent deletion are rejected. POST and complete PUT require a 24-hour idempotency key, with exact original-result replay. Read the contract before building your own synchronization workflow.

Stored-row limits are Basic 30, active Advanced 50, active Jade 100, counting cash and watches. Single-row writes share 30/minute and 100/hour; other calls keep the existing counters. Current-holdings and snapshot reads share one daily read notice; changed writes have one separate modification notice. Revocation stops future access without undoing changes. Request audit records metadata only; replay results are stored encrypted for 24 hours.

Discovery is currently this file and agent.md. Cached valuation preview and the Agent-only OpenAPI URL are not available yet. Do not call planned routes or the disabled full production openapi.json.

## Guides

- [Jade guides index](https://portfonia.com/guides): Public explanations of all five Jade portfolio tools.
- [Historical stress scenarios guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-stress): A historical shock, peak-relative paths and asset-class contributions.
- [Style exposure guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-style): Returns-based style weights, fit and their interpretation.
- [Tracking error guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-tracking): Excess return and variability against daily constant reference weights.

- [Holdings replay guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-replay): Unchanged quantities, total return, metrics, proxies and historical currency conversion through a fixed example.
- [Tail risk (VaR / CVaR) guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-var): Historical loss boundaries, tail averages, overlapping monthly windows and the questionnaire reference through a fixed example.
